_provenance: Seerr 3.4.1 GET /api/v1/settings/radarr and /settings/sonarr, recorded 2026-09-28. Hostnames, keys, names and folders neutralised; every other key verbatim.

_what_the_live_response_settled.why_it_matters: `tagRequests` is what makes Seerr stamp `<seerrUserId>-<username>` on each Radarr/Sonarr item it sends (MediaRequestSubscriber, `radarrSettings.tagRequests`). It is readable, so Shortlist can tell the owner which server has it off instead of silently finding no tags. The published OpenAPI schema omits the key.
